2607.25614.title: MemSFT: Mitigating Alignment Tax with an External Parametric Memory
2607.25614.paper_summary: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specialized domains often incurs an alignment tax, as fine-tuning on domain-specific tasks can cause catastrophic forgetting and substantially degrade performance on general tasks. We propose MemSFT, which mitigates the alignment tax by decoupling domain specialization from backbone parameter updates through a plug-and-play parametric memory. The memory is trained to imitate the behavior of a non-parametric retriever operating over domain data, thereby memorizing knowledge and patterns that would otherwise be accessed through retrieval. Once trained on a specific domain, the memory can be reused across LLMs of different sizes. During generation, a learned router dynamically fuses the output distributions of the memory and backbone at each decoding step, allowing domain expertise to be invoked selectively. Across biology, geoscience, and law, evaluations with models ranging from Qwen3-8B to Qwen3-235B-A22B show that MemSFT consistently improves domain performance with negligible degradation in general performance, whereas full SFT suffers severe forgetting on general tasks. Overall, our results demonstrate a practical path to decoupling general model capabilities from domain-specific knowledge at the parameter level, thereby equipping LLMs with new specialized capabilities without compromising their general capabilities.
2607.25614.paper_summary_zh: 將大型語言模型（LLMs）適應於專業領域通常會產生對齊稅，因為在特定領域任務上的微調可能會導致災難性遺忘，並大幅降低在一般任務上的表現。<lb/>我們提出了MemSFT，它通過一個即插即用的參數記憶體將領域專業化與主幹參數更新解耦，從而減輕對齊稅。<lb/>該記憶體的訓練目的是模仿在領域數據上運作的非參數檢索器的行為，從而記住那些本來需要通過檢索來獲取的知識和模式。<lb/>一旦在特定領域上訓練完成，該記憶體可以在不同大小的LLMs之間重複使用。<lb/>在生成過程中，學習到的路由器在每個解碼步驟中動態融合記憶體和主幹的輸出分佈，允許選擇性地調用領域專業知識。<lb/>在生物學、地球科學和法律領域，對從Qwen3-8B到Qwen3-235B-A22B的模型進行的評估顯示，MemSFT始終能改善領域性能，而對一般性能的降級則微不足道，而完整的SFT在一般任務上遭遇嚴重遺忘。<lb/>總體而言，我們的結果展示了一條在參數層面上將一般模型能力與領域特定知識解耦的實際途徑，從而使LLMs具備新的專業能力而不損害其一般能力。
